# Irfan Investment Group (irfaninvest.com)

> Muscat-based real estate and investment advisory. Freehold property sales in Oman ITC zones (Al Mouj, Muscat Bay, Aida/Yiti, Jebel Sifah, Hawana Salalah), Oman investor residency guidance, company registration and market analytics. Content in English, Persian (Farsi), Arabic and Russian.

Key facts (July 2026):
- Foreigners (including Iranian, Indian and GCC nationals) can buy 100% freehold property in Oman only inside Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITC).
- Live inventory starts at OMR 35,625 (~USD 92,600) for a Jebel Sifah studio; Muscat apartments from OMR 48,125; Hawana Salalah beach chalets from OMR 98,000.
- Property registration fee is ~3% one-off; there is no annual property tax in Oman.
- Buying in an ITC grants a renewable investor residency visa for the buyer and immediate family.
